meta.note: The batch that crosses 1000: the body and family completed, school words, the movement and object verbs every sentence leans on, weather nouns, the levada shelf, question pronouns, and the last handful of counter phrases — é para já included.

cards.ex_t: Dói-me o ombro de carregar a mochila.
cards.ex_trans: My shoulder aches from carrying the backpack.

cards.ex_t: Dormi mal e agora não viro o pescoço.
cards.ex_trans: I slept badly and now I can't turn my neck.

cards.ex_t: Ri até me doer a barriga.
cards.ex_trans: I laughed till my belly hurt.

cards.ex_t: Cortei o dedo a abrir a lata.
cards.ex_trans: I cut my finger opening the tin.

cards.ex_t: Com este sol, protege a pele.
cards.ex_trans: With this sun, protect your skin.

cards.note: cortar o cabelo — to get a haircut
cards.ex_t: Preciso de cortar o cabelo antes da entrevista.
cards.ex_trans: I need a haircut before the interview.

cards.note: o ouvido — the inner ear, the hearing
cards.ex_t: O cão dorme com uma orelha levantada.
cards.ex_trans: The dog sleeps with one ear up.

cards.note: ter bom ouvido — for music and languages
cards.ex_t: Para línguas, o ouvido treina-se todos os dias.
cards.ex_trans: For languages, the ear is trained daily.

cards.ex_t: Fiquei sem voz depois do arraial.
cards.ex_trans: I lost my voice after the festival.

cards.ex_t: É preciso estar em jejum para tirar sangue.
cards.ex_trans: You must fast before a blood draw.

cards.ex_t: A filha trouxe o namorado ao almoço de domingo.
cards.ex_trans: The daughter brought her boyfriend to Sunday lunch.

cards.ex_t: O genro é que faz a espetada na festa.
cards.ex_trans: The son-in-law is the one who grills the espetada.

cards.note: os netos — the reason avós exist
cards.ex_t: Os netos passam agosto com os avós.
cards.ex_trans: The grandkids spend August with the grandparents.

cards.ex_t: Os gémeos só se distinguem pela voz.
cards.ex_trans: The twins can only be told apart by voice.

cards.note: the census word: solteiro, casado, divorciado, viúvo
cards.ex_t: No formulário marquei 'solteiro'.
cards.ex_trans: On the form I ticked 'single'.

cards.ex_t: A vizinha está grávida do segundo.
cards.ex_trans: The neighbour is pregnant with her second.

cards.ex_t: A escola primária fica a cinco minutos.
cards.ex_trans: The primary school is five minutes away.

cards.ex_t: A universidade tem cursos de português para estrangeiros.
cards.ex_trans: The university has Portuguese courses for foreigners.

cards.note: tirar um curso — to do a degree/course
cards.ex_t: Tirei um curso intensivo de verão.
cards.ex_trans: I did an intensive summer course.

cards.ex_t: Escrevo cada palavra nova no caderno.
cards.ex_trans: I write every new word in the notebook.

cards.ex_t: Empresta-me uma caneta para o formulário?
cards.ex_trans: Lend me a pen for the form?

cards.ex_t: O dicionário de bolso salvou-me no talho.
cards.ex_trans: The pocket dictionary saved me at the butcher's.

cards.ex_t: O exercício está na página quarenta.
cards.ex_trans: The exercise is on page forty.

cards.ex_t: Falta um capítulo para acabar o livro.
cards.ex_trans: One chapter left to finish the book.

cards.note: saber de cor — to know by heart
cards.ex_t: Decorei os verbos irregulares a cantar.
cards.ex_trans: I memorised the irregular verbs by singing them.

cards.ex_t: Treino o ouvido com rádio portuguesa.
cards.ex_trans: I train my ear with Portuguese radio.

cards.ex_t: Subimos ao miradouro antes do calor.
cards.ex_trans: We went up to the viewpoint before the heat.

cards.ex_t: Desce na próxima paragem.
cards.ex_trans: Get off at the next stop.

cards.ex_t: Atravessa na passadeira, que a estrada é traiçoeira.
cards.ex_trans: Cross at the zebra — the road is treacherous.

cards.note: siga! — carry on (the bus driver's word)
cards.ex_t: Siga sempre em frente até ao túnel.
cards.ex_trans: Keep straight on until the tunnel.

cards.ex_t: O autocarro não parou — estava cheio.
cards.ex_trans: The bus didn't stop — it was full.

cards.ex_t: Caiu uma árvore na estrada com o vento.
cards.ex_trans: A tree fell on the road in the wind.

cards.ex_t: Os miúdos saltam do cais para o mar.
cards.ex_trans: The kids jump off the pier into the sea.

cards.ex_t: O gato fugiu com o barulho dos foguetes.
cards.ex_trans: The cat ran off at the sound of the fireworks.

cards.ex_t: Com as obras, é sorte chegar a tempo.
cards.ex_trans: With the roadworks, arriving on time is luck.

cards.ex_t: Já é tarde, vou-me embora.
cards.ex_trans: It's late, I'm off.

cards.ex_t: Acende a luz da varanda.
cards.ex_trans: Turn on the balcony light.

cards.ex_t: Apaga o fogão antes de sair!
cards.ex_trans: Turn off the stove before leaving!

cards.ex_t: Guarda o recibo, pode ser preciso.
cards.ex_trans: Keep the receipt, it may be needed.

cards.ex_t: Não atires nada ao mar, nem migalhas.
cards.ex_trans: Don't throw anything into the sea, not even crumbs.

cards.ex_t: Segura o saco enquanto abro a porta.
cards.ex_trans: Hold the bag while I open the door.

cards.note: parti um copo / o barco parte às oito
cards.ex_t: Parti outro copo, desculpa.
cards.ex_trans: I broke another glass, sorry.

cards.note: que número calça? — what size do you take?
cards.ex_t: Que número calça? Quarenta e dois?
cards.ex_trans: What size do you take? Forty-two?

cards.ex_t: Despe o casaco, está calor cá dentro.
cards.ex_trans: Take off your coat, it's warm in here.

cards.ex_t: A saia do traje regional é às riscas.
cards.ex_trans: The folk costume skirt is striped.

cards.ex_t: De calções em novembro — vantagens da ilha.
cards.ex_trans: Shorts in November — island perks.

cards.ex_t: Cá quase ninguém usa gravata.
cards.ex_trans: Almost nobody wears a tie here.

cards.ex_t: Aperta o cinto, a estrada tem curvas.
cards.ex_trans: Buckle up, the road has bends.

cards.ex_t: Deixei a carteira em casa — pagas tu?
cards.ex_trans: I left my wallet at home — your treat?

cards.ex_t: O relógio da sé atrasa cinco minutos.
cards.ex_trans: The cathedral clock runs five minutes slow.

cards.ex_t: O anel era da bisavó.
cards.ex_trans: The ring was great-grandmother's.

cards.ex_t: Uns brincos de filigrana portuguesa.
cards.ex_trans: Portuguese filigree earrings.

cards.ex_t: Uma nuvem parada em cima do Funchal, só uma.
cards.ex_trans: One cloud parked over Funchal, just one.

cards.ex_t: No planalto veem-se estrelas a sério.
cards.ex_trans: On the plateau you see real stars.

cards.ex_t: Com lua cheia nem é preciso lanterna.
cards.ex_trans: With a full moon you don't even need a torch.

cards.note: the word this whole life runs on
cards.ex_t: A ilha ao lado chama-se Porto Santo.
cards.ex_trans: The island next door is called Porto Santo.

cards.note: Madeira word for the stony shore
cards.ex_t: Levamos chinelos por causa do calhau.
cards.ex_trans: We take flip-flops because of the pebbles.

cards.ex_t: O trilho do Pico Ruivo está sinalizado.
cards.ex_trans: The Pico Ruivo trail is signposted.

cards.note: a Laurissilva — the UNESCO laurel forest
cards.ex_t: A floresta Laurissilva é património mundial.
cards.ex_trans: The Laurissilva forest is a World Heritage site.

cards.ex_t: É possível trocar sem talão?
cards.ex_trans: Is it possible to exchange without the receipt?

cards.ex_t: A história é verdadeira, juro.
cards.ex_trans: The story is true, I swear.

cards.ex_t: A nota parecia falsa e era mesmo.
cards.ex_trans: The banknote looked fake and it was.

cards.ex_t: Cá o estrangeiro deixa de o ser depressa.
cards.ex_trans: Here a foreigner stops being one quickly.

cards.ex_t: O bordado da Madeira é famoso no mundo inteiro.
cards.ex_trans: Madeira embroidery is famous worldwide.

cards.ex_t: O norte é mais tranquilo, mesmo em agosto.
cards.ex_trans: The north is calmer, even in August.

cards.ex_t: Alguém deixou o portão aberto.
cards.ex_trans: Someone left the gate open.

cards.note: double negative is correct: não veio ninguém
cards.ex_t: Ninguém atende ao sábado à tarde.
cards.ex_trans: Nobody answers on Saturday afternoon.

cards.ex_t: Cheira-me a algo queimado.
cards.ex_trans: I smell something burning.

cards.ex_t: Não falta nada na mala?
cards.ex_trans: Nothing missing from the suitcase?

cards.ex_t: Cada um paga o seu, combinado?
cards.ex_trans: Everyone pays their own, agreed?

cards.ex_t: Ambos os cafés são bons; um é mais barato.
cards.ex_trans: Both cafés are good; one is cheaper.

cards.ex_t: Qualquer autocarro da linha um serve.
cards.ex_trans: Any bus on line one will do.

cards.note: o próprio dono — the owner himself
cards.ex_t: Foi o próprio chef que trouxe o prato.
cards.ex_trans: The chef himself brought the dish.

cards.ex_t: Sexta às oito, está combinado.
cards.ex_trans: Friday at eight — settled.

cards.ex_t: Pagar dois táxis não faz sentido.
cards.ex_trans: Paying for two taxis makes no sense.

cards.note: shorter cousin of há quanto tempo
cards.ex_t: Quanto tempo! Ainda moras no Caniço?
cards.ex_trans: It's been ages! Still living in Caniço?

cards.ex_t: Bem-vindos à Madeira — cuidado com as subidas.
cards.ex_trans: Welcome to Madeira — mind the climbs.

cards.ex_t: Está certo assim, fique com o troco.
cards.ex_trans: That's fine, keep the change.

cards.note: what the waiter says — now you understand it
cards.ex_t: — Duas imperiais! — É para já.
cards.ex_trans: — Two beers! — Coming right up.

cards.ex_t: Cá está o troco, obrigado eu.
cards.ex_trans: Here's the change — thank YOU.

cards.note: se calhar + indicative — the spoken maybe
cards.ex_t: Se calhar vou à festa, logo se vê.
cards.ex_trans: Maybe I'll go to the festival, we'll see.

cards.ex_t: Dá cá um abraço, e aparece!
cards.ex_trans: Give us a hug — and don't be a stranger!
